# Vendored long-run rig files

Copies of the live files in `~/.long-run/bin` and `~/.long-run/rig/bin`, which are not under git and which every run on this Mac uses. Changes for Caret's heavy jobs are made and tested here first. The coordinator approves installing any change that alters admission for other runs.

Installed state (2026-10-08 01:59Z, after the rig-stop fail-closed fix was installed): every file here matches its live copy in `~/.long-run/bin`, `~/.long-run/rig/bin` and `~/.long-run/lease-policy.json`. That fix: `rig/bin/rig-stop` fails closed when `lr-lease status` fails, times out or prints something other than its report (exit 75, nothing done), as rig-run refuses on the same failure; its test is `rig/bin/test-rig-stop-lease-status.sh`, and `test-rig-stop-only.sh` and `test-rig-stop-orphans.sh` take `RIG_STOP=<path>` like `test-rig-stop-orphan-vm.sh`. Backups of what each install replaced: `~/.long-run/backup/20261007-q2-lease-owner/`, `20261007-q2-lease-install/`, `20261007-q2-clear-fix/`, `20261007-q2-rig-run/` (each with SHA256SUMS), `bin-20261007T221706Z/` (the stop-target install) and `20261008T015946Z-rig-stop-failclosed/` (the rig-stop fix). `diff -r` this directory against the live paths to see what is not installed.

Run the lease tests against this copy: `cd ops/heavy/vendor/long-run/bin && node --test lr-lease.test.mjs` (the test reads `../lease-policy.json` relative to itself, so copy the live policy beside `bin/` first, as `tests` does, or run it in a temporary tree).
